purpose: Alternative pretrained discriminative NLI smoke test, not historical checkpoint reproduction
selection: For each of the 30 subcases, sort pairID lexicographically, select first 10; 300 already-exposed development examples, not random or held-out
input: Only sentence1 then sentence2; no gold label, parse, subcase or template in model input
inference: CPU float32 eval + inference_mode, threads=4, batch=8, max_length=128; report untruncated lengths and truncation; run twice; label argmax over 3 logits then collapse neutral/contradiction, NOT threshold summed negative probabilities
loading: local_files_only=true, trust_remote_code=false, safetensors only; isolated environment, record exact installed distributions
budget: 30 minutes wall limit for inference batch; retain partial output/failure without reporting full-set metrics
checks: weight hash and id2label exactly 0 contradiction 1 entailment 2 neutral
repeat prediction agreement and maximum absolute logit difference
report overall and by gold/subcase; no probability calibration claim
stopping: No prompt/query tuning, no thresholds chosen on these labels; inspect failures before scaling or Rust transfer
